package clientmembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"

	client "example.com/clientmembers/gen/jsonrpc/members/client"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/jsonrpc"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type sendingStream interface {
	Send(string) error
	CloseAndRecv() (string, error)
}

func TestWebSocketClientRoles(t *testing.T) {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	defer close(done)
	peer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		upgrader := websocket.Upgrader{}
		conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		defer func() {
			if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		}()
		for range 5 {
			_, data, err := conn.ReadMessage()
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			var request jsonrpc.RawRequest
			if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &request); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			var payload string
			if err := json.Unmarshal(request.Params, &payload); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			response, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": request.ID, "result": request.Method + ":" + payload})
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, response); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
		}
		<-done
	}))
	defer peer.Close()
	u, err := url.Parse(peer.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c := client.NewClient("ws", u.Host, peer.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false, websocket.DefaultDialer, loomhttp.WebSocketConfig{})
	defer func() {
		if err := c.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if c.IsClosed() {
		t.Error("new client is closed")
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		method   string
		endpoint loom.Endpoint
	}{
		{"close", c.CloseEndpoint()},
		{"isClosed", c.IsClosedEndpoint()},
		{"closeEndpoint", c.CloseEndpointEndpoint()},
		{"doer", c.DoerEndpoint()},
		{"restoreResponseBody", c.RestoreResponseBodyEndpoint()},
	} {
		value, err := test.endpoint(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		stream := value.(sendingStream)
		if err := stream.Send("payload"); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := stream.CloseAndRecv()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if got != test.method+":payload" {
			t.Errorf("method %s result %v", test.method, got)
		}
	}
	if err := c.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !c.IsClosed() {
		t.Error("Close did not set lifecycle state")
	}
	if _, err := c.CloseEndpoint()(ctx, nil); err == nil {
		t.Error("closed client admitted an authored close call")
	}
}
